import React from 'react'
import CommonSection from '../share/CommonSection'
import {Col, Container, Row} from 'reactstrap'
import "../style/tour.css"
import tourData from '../assets/data/tours'
import TourCard from '../share/TourCard'
import SearchBar from '../share/SearchBar'
import Newsletter from '../share/Newsletter'

const Tour = () => {
  return (
    <>
      <CommonSection title={"Tất cả các tour"}/>
      <section>
        <Container>
          <Row>
            <SearchBar/>
          </Row>
        </Container>
      </section>
      <section>
        <Container>
          <Row>
            {
              tourData?.map(tour => <Col lg='3' ><TourCard tour={tour}/></Col>)
            }
          </Row>
        </Container>
      </section>
    </>
  )
}

export default Tour
